Staff Platform Engineer

Requirements
- 8+ years of experience building distributed systems
- Deep expertise in Kubernetes and Docker
- Proven track record leading large technical initiatives
- Required: experience with Terraform and GCP or AWS

Preferred Qualifications
- Experience with Go
- Familiarity with gRPC
- Contributions to open source projects are a plus

Responsibilities
- Mentor junior engineers and guide architecture decisions
- Define the long-term technical roadmap for the platform team
- Partner with staff and principal engineers across the org
